card.hint: Total refills in the period, because each refill fills the tank and equals what was used before it. A first refill with no previous one is not counted, a refill above capacity is capped at it, and remaining = tank capacity minus consumption

donut.consumptionEmpty: Not enough data: consumption needs the tank capacity and a previous refill

trend.title: Refills over the period
trend.noConsumption: No consumption line: it needs the tank capacity and a following refill to show what was used
trend.hint: Consumption is plotted at the refill it was used from; remaining = tank capacity minus what was used
